title: ICONICS GENESIS64 colorpalletes Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of ICONICS GENESIS64. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the colorpalletes endpoint. When parsing the path parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
